sections.heading: A — Exam authority
sections.markdown:
## A — Exam authority

The selected pages of this section cover obeying officers and signs, driving on the right and when the left half may be used, passing on the right, lane use, following distance, divided highways, required signals, railroad crossings, speed rules, prohibited parking, tow-away zones, unattended vehicles, emergency vehicles, funeral processions, the slow-moving vehicle emblem, no-passing situations and right-of-way rules; they state the rules of the road a driver must obey and say nothing about any examination; they state no exam name, question count, passing standard, format or time limit.

The run scope names the Hawaii Department of Transportation as the handbook issuer and the twenty twenty-three printing as the edition, but these pages carry no page-bound issuer or edition statement, so part A asserts no issuer or edition fact of its own.

Question count, passing standard, format and time limit for the class three knowledge test are not stated anywhere in this manual; every official exam fact stays unknown in this envelope and is never guessed.

Corpus note: keeping right, signaling, railroad, speed, parking, emergency vehicle, no-passing and right-of-way rules are statutory facts printed in this twenty twenty-three edition with no annual-rewrite signal on these pages.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the obeying officers and signs, driving on the right and when the left half may be used, passing on the right, lane use, following distance, divided highways, required signals, railroad crossings, speed rules, prohibited parking, tow-away zones, unattended vehicles, emergency vehicles, funeral processions, the slow-moving vehicle emblem, no-passing situations and right-of-way rules rules on pages 26–32 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
